KTR seeks Supreme Court-monitored probe into Election Commission

Telangana Minister K. T. Rama Rao has requested a probe into the functioning of the Election Commission of India (ECI), to be monitored by the Supreme Court. The request was made by KTR, who is also the working president of the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS).
